summary: checkout-api checkout requests are failing with ZeroDivisionError. This looks like a division-by-zero when stock reaches the requested quantity.

observed_facts.statement: The error message was: float division by zero

timeline.event: Tracy detected this as an incident

hypotheses.statement: remaining_after_purchase reached zero when requested quantity equals remaining stock, causing a division by zero

suspected_root_cause: remaining_after_purchase reached zero when requested quantity equals remaining stock, causing a division by zero
recommended_investigation: Inspect calculate_total in checkout-api/app/pricing.py for a zero-guard on remaining_after_purchase
